guard: changed fixture config, suite, or guarded source re-proves its fixture; a deleted or renamed-away source is a loud dangling failure naming the exact fixture; both sides of a rename enter the changed set

mutations.name: the diff excludes deletions again (the original ACMR bug)
mutations.expectRed: the gate FAILS on a deleted guarded source and names exactly the dangling fixture
mutations.cell: the gate FAILS on a deleted guarded source and names exactly the dangling fixture

mutations.name: a rename contributes only its new path, not the old one the fixture still anchors to
mutations.expectRed: the gate FAILS on a renamed-away guarded source and names exactly the dangling fixture
mutations.cell: the gate FAILS on a renamed-away guarded source and names exactly the dangling fixture

mutations.name: a changed configured suite is ignored by changed-set selection
mutations.expectRed: a suite-only change selects exactly the fixture that names that suite
mutations.cell: a suite-only change selects exactly the fixture that names that suite

mutations.name: a dangling fixture is no longer refused, so a deleted source stops being a loud failure
mutations.expectRed: the gate FAILS on a deleted guarded source and names exactly the dangling fixture
mutations.cell: the gate FAILS on a deleted guarded source and names exactly the dangling fixture

mutations.name: a pre-red suite is blamed as a fatal finding instead of reported as its own state
mutations.expectRed: a pre-red selected fixture is reported as PRE-RED, names exactly that fixture, and does NOT fail the gate
mutations.cell: a pre-red selected fixture is reported as PRE-RED, names exactly that fixture, and does NOT fail the gate

mutations.name: verdict lines are matched without stripping ANSI colour, so every verdict reads as absent
mutations.expectRed: an INCONCLUSIVE proof is reported as INCONCLUSIVE, does NOT fail the gate, and is not treated as SURVIVED
mutations.cell: an INCONCLUSIVE proof is reported as INCONCLUSIVE, does NOT fail the gate, and is not treated as SURVIVED

mutations.name: an INCONCLUSIVE run is collapsed into a fatal finding instead of its own non-fatal state
mutations.expectRed: an INCONCLUSIVE proof is reported as INCONCLUSIVE, does NOT fail the gate, and is not treated as SURVIVED
mutations.cell: an INCONCLUSIVE proof is reported as INCONCLUSIVE, does NOT fail the gate, and is not treated as SURVIVED
